ITEM 1 | Pale beige-tan oval sausage-like piece, smooth-skinned with slight speckling, upper-center of plate, about 6 cm long and 3 cm wide, firm and intact, lightly browned spots, sits next to other sausage pieces | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale beige-grey oval piece with speckled surface, slightly glossy, about 5 cm long and 3 cm wide, firm, lower-left of the group of sausage-like pieces | 50
ITEM 3 | Pale tan-grey lumpy oval piece with a small browned edge, about 5 cm by 3 cm, firm, located left-center of plate beside the other sausage-like pieces | 50
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown seared chunk with darker caramelized edges and slightly glossy surface, about 4 cm by 3 cm, firm and dense, center of the plate next to the pale pieces | 45
ITEM 5 | Scrambled eggs: pale yellow curds mixed with orange-tinged streaks, soft, moist, slightly glossy, loosely clumped, covering roughly a fifth of the plate on the right side | 110
ITEM 6 | Orange cubed roasted vegetable pieces, about 2 to 3 cm chunks with browned, slightly caramelized edges and matte-to-glossy surface, firm, lower-left of plate | 90
ITEM 7 | Whole blackberries, dark purple-black with glossy drupelet texture, about 2 cm each, four to five berries clustered lower-right of plate | 40
ITEM 8 | Ripe raspberries, bright red with textured bumpy drupelets, about 1.5 to 2 cm, three berries clustered near the eggs on the right | 20
ITEM 9 | Blackberries, dark purple-black and glossy, about 2 cm each, two to three berries on the upper right next to the eggs | 20
